summary.answer: Creates Hud_MP_Codcaster menu, safe-area child and MP HUD components, current-weapon damage model binding, score notifications and spectator/profile state consumers. On score_event it prioritizes bounty score, then combat-efficiency score when spawn selection is inactive, then normal score. Objective ShowNotification predicates are AlwaysFalse here. HideAllButScoreboard is killcam/final/round/stage visibility union; SpeedBoost uses exact gadget id/state; HideForCodCaster requires spectator profile. X input is blocked only while AreXButtonPressesDisallowed; player_spawned outside draft disallows X400ms. Menu_loaded sizes PC to HUD area and console to safe area, dispatches to children when unhandled; then focus/state restoration, close registration, postload, back-button preservation, grenade warnings and cursor disable occur in literal order.
